$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-DX-008 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §8.10 and the RF-DX-008 inventory entry. Architecture-source rule: evidence_claim_ids intentionally empty per v1.2 §4.3. Expresses strong-anchor conflict handling STRUCTURE only: when a strong documented anchor materially conflicts with the current presentation, preserve both anchor and current evidence, set external_reassessment, block rehabilitation, explain the discrepancy, and create the required referral object. Silent replacement is prohibited. Does not interpret raw imaging (RF-DX-006 governs report descriptors) and does not bypass RF-SAF-006 or any safety rule. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.

input_contract.$comment: Structural trigger taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §8.10. A strong documented anchor materially conflicts with the current presentation. Raw media is never an anchor here.

decision_contract.$comment: Conflict-handling structure only. Preserve both the anchor and current evidence; set external_reassessment; block rehabilitation; explain the discrepancy; create the required referral object. Silent replacement is prohibited. No rehab authorization while unresolved, no numeric values. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Architecture normative source; MUST; permitted_use logic_with_uncertainty. Architecture refs preserved per source: V3.1-6.3 (reconciliation / removal of silent override), V3.1-20 (referral-resolution lifecycle), V3.1-22 (wire cross-object invariants). No evidence_claim_ids are cited (legitimately empty per v1.2 §4.3 — architecture rules need not invent evidence claims; [] means 'none required', not 'missing'). Per §8.10 trigger: a strong documented anchor materially conflicts with the current presentation. Per §8.10 decision: preserve both the anchor and current evidence, set external_reassessment, block rehabilitation, explain the discrepancy, and create the required referral object; silent replacement is prohibited. Safety-state choice (§8.10 read exactly): §8.10 explicitly instructs to 'block rehabilitation', which is the closed V3.1 §21 state REHAB_BLOCKED; therefore safety_state_output is REHAB_BLOCKED with blocked_targets ['rehab'] (consistent with RF-SAF-006). 'external_reassessment' is a referral-resolution disposition (V3.1 §20), not one of the eight closed safety states, so it is represented in decision_contract (set_external_reassessment / create_required_referral_object) rather than in safety_state_output; this matches the V3.1 §22 invariant that a strong-anchor/presentation conflict requires external_reassessment, a matching referral, and a rehabilitation block. Raw or uploaded scan images are not a diagnosis anchor (RF-DX-006 handles report descriptors; V3.1 §25); serious structural/restriction concerns defer to RF-SAF-006; safety is never bypassed because an external diagnosis exists. No diagnostic confidence model is authored here (deferred to the later confidence objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
